AddCustomQA.description_en: The Add Custom Q&A feature in the Custom Q&A module
AddCustomQA.description_zh: 自定义问答模块下的新增自定义问答功能

AddOrUpdateDisPlayModes.description_en: Applies only to screen-equipped Maojing devices and is used to set the list of display patterns on screen-equipped devices
AddOrUpdateDisPlayModes.description_zh: 仅带屏猫精设备生效，用于设置带屏设备上展示的模式列表

AddOrUpdateHotelSetting.description_zh: 新增或者更新酒店定制

AddOrUpdateScreenSaver.description_en: Applies only to MeowJing devices with screens. Configure the screen saver settings for screen-equipped devices
AddOrUpdateScreenSaver.description_zh: 仅带屏猫精设备生效，设置带屏设备的屏保配置

CheckoutWithAK.description_en: Check out and clear scheduled services such as alarms and reminders, as well as order information, from the CatGenie device
CheckoutWithAK.description_zh: 退房，清理猫精设备上的定时类服务，例如闹钟、提醒，以及订单信息

ChildAccountAuth.description_en: Authorize a RAM user for a hotel

ControlRoomDevice.description_en: Control infrared or Mesh devices in hotel rooms.
ControlRoomDevice.description_zh: 酒店房间内红外或Mesh设备控制

DeleteCustomQA.description_en: The delete custom Q&A pair feature in the Custom Q&A module
DeleteCustomQA.description_zh: 自定义问答模块下的删除自定义问答功能

DeleteHotelAlarm.description_en: Delete hotel alarms, supporting both single and batch deletion
DeleteHotelAlarm.description_zh: 删除酒店闹钟，支持单个和批量删除

DeleteHotelSetting.description_en: Delete hotel customization, including home page background, screensaver background, and more
DeleteHotelSetting.description_zh: 删除酒店定制 包含首页背景、屏保背景等等

DeleteRcuScene.description_en: Delete a custom hotel RCU scenario

DeviceControl.description_en: Control hotel guest room devices, such as lights, air conditioners, curtains, and other in-room controllable devices.
DeviceControl.description_zh: 酒店客控设备控制，可控制例如灯、空调、窗帘等房间内的客控设备

GetBasicInfoQA.description_en: The feature for retrieving basic information Q&A pairs under the general Q&A module
GetBasicInfoQA.description_zh: 通用问答模块下的获取基础信息问答功能

GetHotelContactByGenieDevice.description_en: Obtain the call information of the current device
GetHotelContactByGenieDevice.description_zh: 获取当前设备的通话信息

GetHotelContactByNumber.description_zh: 根据号码查询联系人信息

GetHotelHomeBackImageAndModes.description_en: Obtain the home page background image and scenario modes
GetHotelHomeBackImageAndModes.description_zh: 获取首页背景图和场景模式

GetHotelNoticeV2.description_en: Obtain hotel notification information, including the notification title and content
GetHotelNoticeV2.description_zh: 获取酒店通知信息，包含通知标题和内容

GetHotelOrderDetail.description_en: Obtain hotel order details, such as screenless services, maintenance, catering, etc.
GetHotelOrderDetail.description_zh: 获取酒店订单详情，例如无屏、维修、餐饮等

GetHotelRoomDevice.description_en: Query channel MeowJing device information, such as device MAC, SN, online status, etc
GetHotelRoomDevice.description_zh: 查询房间猫精设备信息，如设备mac、sn、在线状态等

GetHotelScreenSaver.description_en: Obtain screen saver information, such as the screen saver Style
GetHotelScreenSaver.description_zh: 获取屏保信息，如屏保样式等信息

GetHotelScreenSaverStyle.description_en: Query the available styles for the hotel screen saver background
GetHotelScreenSaverStyle.description_zh: 查询酒店屏保背景的可选样式

GetHotelSetting.description_en: Query hotel customization (including screensaver background, home page background, etc.)
GetHotelSetting.description_zh: 查询酒店定制（包含屏保背景、首页背景等等）

GetRelationProductList.description_en: Obtain the list of associated products used for hotel creation
GetRelationProductList.description_zh: 获得创建酒店使用的关联产品列表

GetUnionId.description_en: Exchange an Open ID for a cross-domain Union ID
GetUnionId.description_zh: 使用open id换取跨域的union id

HotelQrBind.description_en: Scan a QR code to attach a hotel screen-equipped device
HotelQrBind.description_zh: 酒店带屏设备扫码绑定

ImportHotelConfig.description_zh: 批量导入酒店相关配置

ImportRoomControlDevices.description_en: Import the list of guest room control devices for a channel
ImportRoomControlDevices.description_zh: 导入房间的客控设备列表

ImportRoomGenieScenes.description_en: Batch import the list of Intelligent scenarios in a channel.
ImportRoomGenieScenes.description_zh: 批量导入房间内智能智能场景列表

InsertHotelSceneBookItem.description_en: Add a new hotel scenario booking

InvokeRobotPush.description_en: Push robot notifications, which can be used to notify when placing or retrieving items via a robot
InvokeRobotPush.description_zh: 推送机器人通知，可用于机器人送物的放与拿时候的通知

ListAllProvinces.description_en: Query the provinces where infrared is used
ListAllProvinces.description_zh: 查询红外使用的省份信息

ListCitiesByProvince.description_en: Query the list of cities where infrared is used by province
ListCitiesByProvince.description_zh: 根据省份查询红外使用的城市列表

ListCustomQA.description_en: The feature of querying the custom Q&A pair list in the Custom Q&A module
ListCustomQA.description_zh: 自定义问答模块下的查询自定义问答列表功能

ListHotelInfo.description_en: Query hotel list information, such as hotel name, address, and authorized account
ListHotelInfo.description_zh: 查询酒店列表信息，例如酒店名称、地址、授权账号等

ListHotelOrder.description_en: Query the order list on a device
ListHotelOrder.description_zh: 查询设备上的订单列表

ListHotelRooms.description_en: Retrieve hotel channels, which can be refined to a specific channel number
ListHotelRooms.description_zh: 获取酒店房间，可细化至房间号

ListHotelSceneBookItems.description_en: Hotel scenario reservation list (dining / SPA and leisure / ride-hailing)
ListHotelSceneBookItems.description_zh: 酒店场景预订列表（餐饮/SPA休闲/打车）

ListHotelSceneItem.description_en: Query the list of service items in hotel scenarios, such as the service item list for item services
ListHotelSceneItem.description_zh: 查询酒店场景服务项列表，如物品服务的服务项列表

ListHotelSceneItems.description_zh: 查询酒店场景服务（物品/服务/维修）

ListHotelServiceCategory.description_en: Obtain hotel service categories, such as the various categories under hotel services and hotel reservations.
ListHotelServiceCategory.description_zh: 获取酒店服务分类，例如酒店服务于酒店预定下的各个分类

ListHotels.description_en: Obtain a hotel List (pending approval, denied, or passed), which can be refined to a single hotel
ListHotels.description_zh: 获取酒店列表（待审批/已拒绝/已通过），可细化至单个酒店

ListInfraredDeviceBrands.description_en: Query the list of infrared brands

ListInfraredRemoteControllers.description_en: Query the list of infrared code libraries

ListServiceQA.description_en: The feature of querying the Q&A pair list for service facilities under the General Q&A module.
ListServiceQA.description_zh: 通用问答模块下的查询服务设施问答列表功能

PageGetHotelRoomDevices.description_zh: 根据酒店分页查询房间主控设备

QueryDeviceStatus.description_en: Query the status of guest room control devices, such as the toggle status of lights or the current temperature setting of an air conditioner. You can also query the status of certain patterns, such as Do Not Disturb mode (requires prior support from the ISV)
QueryDeviceStatus.description_zh: 查询客控设备状态，例如灯的开关状态，空调当前设定的温度等，也可查询部分模式的状态，例如勿扰模式(需ISV提前支持)

QueryHotelRoomDetail.description_en: Query room details, including hotel information, guest control information, CatGenie device information, guest service requests, and more
QueryHotelRoomDetail.description_zh: 房间详情查询，查询包含酒店信息、客控信息、猫精设备信息、客需信息等

QueryRoomControlDevices.description_en: Query the list of guest room control devices, excluding information such as status
QueryRoomControlDevices.description_zh: 查询房间客控设备列表，不包含状态等信息

QueryRoomControlDevicesAndStatus.description_en: Query the controlled devices in a channel, including device status
QueryRoomControlDevicesAndStatus.description_zh: 查询房间被控设备包含设备状态

QuerySceneList.description_en: Query the list of hotel scenarios

RoomCheckOut.description_en: Clicking Check-out on the device panel initiates an informal check-out process, which only sends a ticket and prompts the user to check out at the front desk
RoomCheckOut.description_zh: 设备面板点击退房，非正式退房，仅发送工单并给用户提示去前台退房

SubmitHotelOrder.description_en: Submit an order, such as an order for items or reserved meals
SubmitHotelOrder.description_zh: 提交订单，例如物品、预定餐饮等订单的提交

SyncDeviceStatusWithAk.description_en: Synchronize the status of guest room control (RCU) devices integrated via cloud-to-cloud integration to the Maojing side, where Maojing stores the status information or notifies the device side to update its status display
SyncDeviceStatusWithAk.description_zh: 用于云云RCU对接的客控设备状态同步至猫精侧，猫精侧存储状态信息或者通知设备端更新状态显示

UpdateBasicInfoQA.description_en: Modify the basic information Q&A feature under the general Q&A module.
UpdateBasicInfoQA.description_zh: 通用问答模块下的修改基础信息问答功能

UpdateCustomQA.description_en: The feature for modifying custom Q&A pairs in the Custom Q&A module
UpdateCustomQA.description_zh: 自定义问答模块下的修改自定义问答功能

UpdateHotelSceneItem.description_zh: 酒店场景修改（开启/关闭/编辑）

UpdateMessageTemplate.description_zh: 修改编辑消息通知模板

UpdateServiceQA.description_en: Modify the service facility Q&A feature under the general Q&A module
UpdateServiceQA.description_zh: 通用问答模块下的修改服务设施问答功能
